name: Hierarchical Space-Filling Curve Data Distribution
definition: A data distribution scheme that uses hierarchical space-filling curves to create a one-dimensional ordering of volume blocks for parallel processing, combined with error-guided bucketization to balance workload based on spatial and temporal errors.
summary: Hierarchical Space-Filling Curve Data Distribution partitions wavelet volume blocks among processors using error-guided bucketization to minimize communication and ensure load balancing.
